description:
No spec subject

Ready-for: investigate

Symptom: while timing PR 8 (the tag-scan fix) against Argos at aa8f738f7, the PR-style mix spec.review run over 297 changed files wrote a 64 MB HTML report. The review spec keeps a 200-file test case under 1 MB, so the size grows far faster than the file count suggests.

Evidence: reported by the ancora-spec-check-perf agent (herdr w2H:pJ) on 2026-11-13, in its final report for PR 8. The run was local, with the same inputs as the timing table in that PR. Not reproduced since.

Start by rerunning spec.review on Argos with a 297-file change set and measuring which section of the HTML dominates the size.
title: spec.review HTML is 64 MB for a 297-file PR change set
